crossRefs.note: He will set his battering engines against your walls, and with his axes he will break down your towers.
He has stretched out his hand over the sea. He has shaken the kingdoms. Yahweh has ordered the destruction of Canaan’s…
“Go up on her walls, and destroy; but don’t make a full end. Take away her branches, for they are not Yahweh’s.
but I will send a fire on the wall of Tyre, and it will devour its palaces.”
Tyre built herself a stronghold, and heaped up silver like the dust, and fine gold like the mire of the streets.
They will make a plunder of your riches, and make a prey of your merchandise. They will break down your walls, and…
He shall cause the inside of the house to be scraped all over. They shall pour out the mortar that they scraped off…
“ ‘ “For her blood is in the middle of her. She set it on the bare rock. She didn’t pour it on the ground, to cover it…
That it may cause wrath to come up to take vengeance, I have set her blood on the bare rock, that it should not be…

people.name: Tyre
people.line: A major Phoenician port city, known for its trade

translations.web: They will destroy the walls of Tyre, and break down her towers. I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her a bare rock.
translations.bsb: They will destroy the walls of Tyre and demolish her towers. I will scrape the soil from her and make her a bare rock.
translations.kjv: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyrus, and break down her towers: I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her like the top of a rock.
translations.asv: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyre, and break down her towers: I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her a bare rock.
